[1/2] Repair ADR-304 control characters and record ADR-305 for the default-topic license-kind correction

impact_assessment.why: ADR-304 was committed with BEL and form-feed characters that hide letters, and its warning correction needs a durable decision record
impact_assessment.benefits: Readable decision history and ADR-305 pinning the corrected warning behavior
impact_assessment.risks: contract: documentation only; dependency: none; concurrency: another agent committed the code fix; state: decisions.md only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Check knowledge integrity, secret scan and focused tests, then commit and push docs alone

[1/4] Plan: close the follow-up gaps in the media/topic self-healing feature (readme-only failure path, attach/fix resilience, single topic warning, docs)

impact_assessment.why: The self-healing feature silently succeeds when media apply --readme-only has no README, attach and fix can crash on a failed candidate write, check and fix can print the same topic warning twice, and the new behaviour is undocumented
impact_assessment.benefits: Every new path either reports an actionable error or a single warning, attach cannot be aborted by an unwritable assets folder, and the command matrix documents the self-healing and readme-only paths
impact_assessment.risks: contract: check output order and media apply exit codes; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: none; state: project README and .aikit/media.json writes only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests for the readme-only gap and single-warning output, focused test runs, then the full Phase 4 triad and read-only gates

[1/3] Review the last three AIKit pushes, surface the swallowed media-read failure in fix, verify every gate, then push

impact_assessment.why: cmd_fix wraps the approved-media README step in a bare except that silently drops a corrupt or unsupported media manifest, so fix reports success while media stays unrepaired
impact_assessment.benefits: A failed media read is reported as one actionable warning, matching the seeding path that ADR-306 already hardened
impact_assessment.risks: contract: fix output gains one WARN line; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: .aikit/media.json is read only, never rewritten
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit test for an unsupported schema, full budget gate plus read-only gates, then push

[1/4] Plan: add a dossier catalogue sync module, invoked automatically after a successful publish, that upserts metadata, snapshot, license ledger, site card/JSON-LD, README row and the catalogue set, then rebuilds the repo media

impact_assessment.why: Publishing a project left the AegeanWorks dossier catalogue stale, so newly published repositories had no site card, README row, license family or media and their manifests were assembled by hand
impact_assessment.benefits: One publish keeps the dossier consistent: catalogue data, site card, README atlas, license ledger and schema-2 media are generated from the repository's own GitHub facts
impact_assessment.risks: contract: publish output and dossier files; dependency: gh CLI already used by publish; concurrency: dossier writes are atomic and the dossier stays uncommitted for review; state: dossier files and media
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit tests against a synthetic dossier fixture plus an idempotency check on an existing catalogue entry, then the dossier's own 95-test suite and AIKit Phase 4 gates
